## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no credentials or private manuscript text. / 改动范围聚焦，且不包含凭据或私人手稿正文。
- [ ] Behavior changes have tests. / 行为变化已有测试。
- [ ] Public guidance is updated in both Chinese and English. / 面向用户的说明已同步更新中英文版本。
- [ ] Upstream attribution and the MIT license remain intact. / 上游署名和 MIT 许可证保持完整。
- [ ] Story Canon and Review Gates were not changed as a side effect of maintenance. / 工程维护没有意外改动故事 Canon 或 Review Gate。
